countByStatus.insight: 62.5% of trials are completed, providing a solid if small evidence base. Two trials actively recruiting in Portugal (2025) signal continued growth.

countByCountry.insight: Europe dominates. Turkey and Portugal are the most active contributors. No trials from USA, Germany, England, France, or Brazil — major research gaps in the biggest women's football markets.

countBySponsorType.insight: 100% academic sponsorship. Zero industry or federation-sponsored trials registered on ClinicalTrials.gov. Major governing bodies (FIFA, UEFA, national FAs) are not registering formal trials.

countByPhase.insight: N/A phase is standard for exercise/behavioural intervention studies. The single Phase 2 trial (NCT06789900) includes a pharmacological component (Everolimus). Quality differentiator is study design (RCT vs single-group).

research_gaps: No trials from USA, Germany, England, France, Brazil, Australia
No long-season (>6 month) periodised S&C intervention trials

No trials examining menstrual cycle effects on training adaptation
No combined concurrent training (strength + endurance) RCTs
